VBO:0201384.summary: Confidence, loyalty and watchfulness are emphasized in the Victorian Bulldog registry standard. It allows well-socialized mature dogs to show more composure and reserve around neutral strangers. This modern English breeding project traces to Ken Mollett in the 1980s, with a later association formed to preserve it.
VBO:0201384.shortDescription: A modern English bulldog program whose registry standard emphasizes confidence, loyalty and mature composure.

sources.title: Continental Kennel Club — current Victorian Bulldog standard
sources.evidence: Confident, loyal, alert and watchful normative character; well-socialized mature dogs may be more self-composed and reserved with neutral strangers. Ken Mollett contemporary1980s breeding project described. Literal sturdy slightly rectangular moderate-boned body, developed broad head with projecting shorter square muzzle, moderate natural rose/button/tulip ears and normal eyes; complete balanced limbs/compact paws; full natural thick-base taper hock-reaching tail straight or slight saber allowed, no dock/stump/screw/ring/overback. Internal numeric muzzle ratio and crank contradictions expressly excluded. No safety/suitability, ancient continuity or health superiority adopted.

sources.title: Victorian Bulldog Alliance Europe — originating registry history
sources.evidence: VBA states established2010 by John Regal to preserve the Victorian Bulldog using Ken Mollett standard with changes; distinguishes Victorian, Old Tyme and Old English Bulldog programs, British modern selection initiated1985. No ancient recreation pedigree or universal federation recognition inferred.
